sources.title: CalMatters 2026 Voter Guide: Governor
sources.quote: Hilton wants to eliminate state income tax on the first $150,000 of Californians’ earnings, and make the income tax a flat rate above that.

sources.quote: Hilton wants to roll back California’s climate rules that mandate a transition to clean energy and a reduction in greenhouse gas emissions in favor of more consumer-friendly policies.

stances.summary: Supports the sanctuary law and defended it in court as attorney general.
